column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule overrides
# STATUS
#   No project-specific rule overrides are currently configured.
#   This file is NOT currently consumed by scripts/ci/run-dast.sh. There is no
#   `-c` argument in the ZAP invocation, so nothing in this file affects scan
#   results today. It is a documented placeholder only.
#   Adding approved overrides and wiring `-c` into the ZAP invocation is future
#   work. Both belong in the same change, so the file cannot silently claim an
#   effect it does not have.
# WHY IT IS EMPTY
#   Suppressing an alert or downgrading its severity is a security decision that
#   needs review, not a build fix. No suppressions have been reviewed or
#   approved for this project, and none should be added to make a scan pass.
# FORMAT, once approved overrides exist
#   <rule-id>\t<action>\t[<parameter>\t<value>]\t# <reason>
#    10038\tIGNORE\t\t# Reviewed YYYY-MM-DD: not applicable to this deployment.
#    10063\tWARN\t\t# Downgraded pending server-header configuration.
#   Actions: IGNORE (never report), WARN (report but do not fail), FAIL.
# BEFORE ADDING A RULE
#   Confirm the finding against the deployed test environment, and record the
#   reason and date inline above the rule.
